_checks: meta.json external_mods_listed names C:/claude-code/pmr_0.4.0 (the game's own mod list), and build_state.json reads arm external+org.prob32.pmr.
PMR's own start marker in debug.log (PMR;rec=LOADED) and telemetry's BOOT / BEGIN lines under this run's token: both mods' on_actions fired.
DLC (L50): every DLC mounted, as in the vanilla run.
rakaly melts a PMR save and save_state_summary.mjs writes a summary with every country's gdp, pop_statistics, strata and investment_pool.

error.log: PMR's own start-up classes (its page says starting buildings ask for methods it merges), counted against the vanilla run beside it, as the noise baseline for the batch's smoke checks.
The pace of the first decade against the vanilla run beside it (directional, n=1, the cheap decade).

_predictions.load: Both mods load and neither replaces the other's files: PMR hangs its effects on vanilla on_actions through on_actions lists of its own names, as telemetry does, and no file name is shared.
_predictions.summaries: The save summaries read as on vanilla (PMR keeps vanilla's building keys and adds only building_pmr_retool_* types).
_predictions.pace: PMR's first decade plays slower than vanilla's (its page: a monthly script runs per building); magnitude unknown.

_stop_rule: None; a probe. A failed check is fixed before the batch is launched.
_cost: 2 x 1836->1846, about 8 minutes a run plus builds and harvest: about 20 minutes.
